key_insight: TCSP3.0 substantially improves template-based crystal structure prediction, with most gains coming from fixing composition errors rather than adding scoring complexity.
engineering_relevance: Composition-safe template reuse offers an efficient route to candidate crystal structures, reaching 67.8% Top-1 accuracy without relaxation at a median 28 seconds per target on two CPU cores.
method: Enforce coefficient-preserving element mappings, substitute species simultaneously on parsed structures, and validate composition and cell.
Combine embedding-based and periodic-number retrieval with oxidation-state evidence, radius compatibility, and structural deduplication.
Relax and rank candidates using the ORB-v3 machine-learning potential.
evidence_signal: On T180, TCSP3.0 achieves 72.2% Top-1 and 90.6% Top-20 match rates versus TCSP2.0's 28.3% and 45.6%; Top-20 reaches 74.0% on T800, with paired ten-arm ablations supporting the importance of correctness fixes.
watch_item: Prediction remains dependent on suitable template coverage; ablations indicate embedding-based retrieval is necessary, while several added scoring features have small or null effects.
paper_title: TCSP3.0: Template-Based Crystal Structure Prediction with Coefficient-Preserving Element Substitution and Structural Diversity
